rule: Each call in a multi-line method chain is reported on the line of its own method name, not the chain's first line. ... **Parameterless members are typed receivers (decision A)**: a receiver that is a call of a parameterless method ... with a declared type ... names that type ... Call on a computed receiver (call result, ...): `.member`
notes: call_type convention (SPEC names the six call_types but does not define direct vs method): a call with no written receiver is direct; a call with a written receiver (obj., this., super., a type or object name) is method; a class-name call `T(..)` that resolves to a constructor, and `: this(..)` / `: super(..)` / a supertype-list call, are constructor. Kotlin has no `new`; a `val x = T(..)` constructor call is treated as decision A's `= new T(...)`. start()/filter() are parameterless with declared return type Pipeline, so the next link is typed Pipeline. limit(n: Int) has a parameter, so `.done()` on its result is a computed receiver: `.done`, low (still emitted, C4). Each edge is on its own method-name line.
